text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired — p99 latency exceeded threshold for service=model-serving-prod. Alert ID PD-98127. Metric: p99=1.55s (>1.2s). Triggered at 17:02 UTC. Routed to: @Alice, @Ben (oncall). Link: https://pagerduty.example/alerts/PD-98127

PagerDutyBot: Page sent to Alice (oncall). Auto-escalation in 5m.

Alice: Ack. I'm on it. Starting triage. Checking recent deploys and autoscaler metrics.

Ben: Ack. I'm awake. Pulling traces and KV cache eviction logs.

Alice: Early note — spike looks concentrated in eu-west region, high QPS to model-large-v2. Could be batching + hot keys.

Carlos: I'm looking at sidecar queue lengths. Seeing continuous 200-500ms build-up before GPU ingress.

Dana: Running quick query on autoscaler: `curl -s http://autoscaler.prod.local/metrics | grep model-serving` — shows CPU at 98% on nodepool-a, pods=12 -> desired=12, scale inhibited by quota.

Alice: Can we shift some traffic to model-large-v1 (compatible) as short-term fallback?

Ben: Yes, we have compatible smaller variant. Recommend: enable routing override to fallback model for 20% of requests for 10m to reduce tail.

Alice: Doing the routing override now: `/infra/routing/override set --service=model-serving-prod --percent=20 --model=model-large-v1 --ttl=10m` (running)

PagerDutyBot: Alice acknowledged PD-98127 at 17:04 UTC.

IncidentBot: Noted. Adding runbook note: "try routing fallback, check kvcache, escalate to SRE if p99 > 1.5s persists."

Carlos: Found increased KV cache evictions: keys/sec = 12k (baseline 800). Looks like hotkey from a single tenant.

Dana: Can we identify tenant? Logs show user_id=customer-24k in 70% of hotkey hits.

Eve: Paging Solutions Eng to evaluate rate limiting for that tenant. @Alice can you confirm if customer-24k is on Dedicated? Might be high fanout from their job.

Alice: customer-24k uses hosted, but heavy batched transforms. Reached out to CS to notify. @Ben monitoring traces for tail latencies.

Ben: Applying temporary per-tenant throttle at edge: `edgectl throttle set --tenant=customer-24k --rate=50rps --burst=100` (applied)

Carlos: After throttle + routing override, p99 dropped to 1.1s in eu-west in the last 60s. :thumbsup: 

Alice: Good. Next — need longer term: recommend adding kvcache size increase for eu-west and revisit autoscaler cooldown config.

Dana: Confirmed nodepool quota is the blocker for scale. Filing internal ticket to increase pool: INFRA-7291.

Alice: Noting customer impact: degraded tail responses for some requests (slow >1s) for ~5-12 minutes. CS notified. No 5xx errors observed, only high latency.

PagerDutyBot: Auto-escalation canceled (ack). No further PD escalation.

Ben: Captured heap snapshots and logs to S3: s3://redwood-incidents/PD-98127/ (traces, heap, kvcache-metrics). Link: https://s3.example/redwood/PD-98127

Alice: Preparing short post-incident summary for handoff to next oncall: will include timeline, mitigation (routing override, tenant throttle), follow-ups (increase kvcache, quota bump INFRA-7291), owner assignments.

Eve: Noted. I'll coordinate with CS on customer-24k notification and support playbook.

Carlos: Leaving ops notes in runbook and tagging for SRE: @sre-team

Alice: Handing off to @Dana (next oncall) at 17:26 UTC. All mitigations still in place — will run cleanup in 30m unless stable.

Dana: Taking over. I'll monitor for 30m and then rollback routing override if stable.

IncidentBot: Thread closed by Alice at 17:30 UTC — summary appended."
